name: Ranger waterskin releases its potion-pool cooldown with a cooldown event (#8006)
contract: Waterskins declare item spell category 5004, whose SpellCategory flag 0x04 makes the client hold the item and the whole 5004 pool until SMSG_COOLDOWN_EVENT (309). Using a waterskin out of combat must therefore send SMSG_COOLDOWN_EVENT for its spell, exactly as Minor Healing Potion 118 (spell 439) does, and still apply the shared ~60s server cooldown to the waterskin and potion spells. Without the event the client keeps the waterskin locked until relog.

steps.label: REF: potion sends SMSG_COOLDOWN_EVENT for 439 out of combat
FIX: waterskin sends SMSG_COOLDOWN_EVENT for 800269 out of combat
POOL: waterskin spell 800269 is on the shared cooldown
POOL: potion spell 439 is on the shared cooldown
